description: MOP - Informes de trabajos de Mantenimientos Viales a nivel Nacional en Panamá is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Obras Públicas. Detalles de los trabajos realizados de mantenimientos vial a nivel Nacional en Panamá. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Obras Públicas. Its tags are Informes, Mantenimiento Vial, Reparaciones, Trabajos de Campo, Vialidad. It offers 39 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2024-01-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Otra (Abierta). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
